title: The Virgo Queen wins Canada's Drag Race Season 5
summary: In the Grand Finale (CA-S05-E09), The Virgo Queen and Makayla Couture lip-synced to Shania Twain's "From This Moment On". The Virgo Queen was crowned the winner; Makayla finished as runner-up. Helena Poison and Minhi Wang were eliminated before the final lip sync. The season cash prize was $100,000 CAD.

title: Tara Nova: Season 5 Porkchop
summary: Tara Nova was the first contestant eliminated on Canada's Drag Race Season 5 (CA-S05-E02), after the premiere sent no one home. She lip-synced to Peaches' "Fuck the Pain Away" against Tiffany Ann Co.; Perla had used the Golden Beaver to save Xana from the bottom three.

title: Jaylene Tyme named Miss Congeniality
summary: Jaylene Tyme was voted Miss Congeniality by fellow contestants. She had been eliminated in CA-S05-E05 after lip-syncing to Love Inc.'s "Here Comes the Sunshine" against Xana; Makayla Couture had used the Golden Beaver to save Helena Poison from that week's bottom three.

title: Golden Beaver and Wooden Beaver return
summary: Season 5 brought back the Golden Beaver, letting each maxi-challenge winner save one of the bottom three from lip-syncing (saves included Xana in E02, Jaylene Tyme in E03, Makayla Couture in E04, and Helena Poison in E05). In Snatch Game (CA-S05-E06), challenge winner Xana started a Wooden Beaver chain that saved Perla, Helena Poison, and Minhi Wang, leaving Makayla Couture, The Virgo Queen, and Uma Gahd in a bottom three.

title: The Virgo Queen takes two of the first three maxis
summary: The Virgo Queen won the premiere lip sync for the win to Lu Kala's "Pretty Girl Era" (CA-S05-E01), then won the Teams Edition Slayoffs (CA-S05-E03) and used the Golden Beaver to save Jaylene Tyme before Perla and Tiffany Ann Co. lip-synced to Avril Lavigne's "Hot".
